work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CXLIX detaches Van Diemen’s Land and South Australia from the New Holland vicariate under bishops of Hobart and Adelaide and gives Polding the title of Sydney; decree, non obstantibus and dating clause survive. The raw candidate ended at LF29836 only because the running-title fragment LF29839 was proposed as a heading. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF29789–29789; the source dating clause at LF29905–29908 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die quinta aprilis millesimo octingen- tesimo quadragesimo secundo, pontificatus No- stri anno decimo secundo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
